description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Extend one of the account's active rentals by 1 or 30 days. Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged. (2) Only after the user approved that charge, call again with confirm: true and that requestId. If the price rose meanwhile the API refuses instead of charging more, and repeating a confirmed requestId returns the same order without charging again. Needs a read-write API key, an agent token that may buy, or the order's invoice ID.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview the charge. Set true, with the preview requestId, only after the user approved that charge.

requestId.description: The requestId the preview returned, copied exactly. Use it only with confirm: true.

name: extend_rental
title: Extend a rental (spends balance)
